title: Prescriptions Terms for Patients: Locker, Drive-Thru and Home Delivery by Class
content:
Kestrel releases a filled prescription through the counter, a self-service pickup locker, the drive-thru window or home delivery. For Kestrel Prescriptions, the handling class of the prescription decides which of the last three channels may carry it and whether a delivered fill needs an adult signature on handover.

| Handling class | Pickup locker | Drive-thru window | Home delivery | Adult signature on delivered handover |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | No | No | Yes | Yes |

A Yes means a fill of the class may be released through that channel; a No means it may not. The signature column applies to a delivered fill of the class.

## Questions answered by the table

**May a Schedule II Controlled Prescription be sent by home delivery?** No; its home delivery column is No.

**May a Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription be collected at the drive-thru?** No; it may go by home delivery, with an adult signature on handover.

**Which classes may use a pickup locker?** Non-Controlled Acute Prescription, Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription and Schedule V Controlled Prescription.
